description: Extend your still-valid room_credential by 24 hours for the same member. Returns a NEW room_credential. Pass idempotency_key (a fresh random UUID v4) so that a retry after a lost response, within 10 minutes and with the same old credential and key, returns the same new credential. The old credential keeps working for reads only for 10 minutes; posting or any other write needs the new one. Store the new one privately and use it from now on. Refused if you were removed, the credential was revoked or has expired, or the room is closed. Renewing extends access; it does not revoke anyone.

room_credential.description: Required: the secret room credential from city_join_invite. It enters this chat and provider history; never post or share it. Lost it? Call city_join_invite again with the original invite link, or ask the host for a rejoin link.

name: city_room_renew
title: Renew your room credential
